results.title: Remanence
results.overview: After creating a powerful liquid that grants superhuman abilities, a scientist races to keep it from criminals and prevent global disaster.

results.title: The King of Chaos
results.overview: An emotionally-immature man sets out to rescue his estranged lover from a supernatural conversion camp.

results.title: Autostop
results.overview: For years, Floriane has been recording her conversations with the drivers who picked her up as a hitchhiker. She now re-enacts these scenarios with two actors, who perform the exchanges word for word with the help of an earpiece.

results.title: Parasite 2
results.overview: When Tootsie meets Mark, a well-known street figure, sparks fly. However, Tootsie's schemes land her in hot water when she falls for a vengeful figure, Lucas, who has a hidden agenda against Mark. Torn between her parasitic habits and genuine affection, Tootsie must make a harrowing choice as her manipulative tendencies bring her face-to-face with the consequences of her actions.

results.title: American Clown
results.overview: Clowns have been a symbol of humor and laughter since they first donned the iconic red nose and oversized shoes. Those who devote their lives to the craft spend years perfecting it. From circuses to birthday parties to movies, clowns are everywhere in our culture, but what happens when the laughter fades and the greasepaint runs? One man sets out to find what's left of American's once beloved profession.

results.title: Goethe!
results.overview: Based on the 2021 German musical Goethe!, which is based on the 2010 German film of the same title,

results.title: The Keepers
results.overview: Amidst a desolate interstellar terrain, space faring outlaws Porter and Kai are thrust into an adventure to safeguard an ally's enigmatic transmission from a relentless adversary.

results.title: Director
results.overview: The main character has a dream: he wants to become a director. On his way to achieving it, he faces many challenges, and the hardest one is his divorce from his family. But he doesn’t give up and finally reaches his dream. Now, he must win his family back!

results.title: Max Needs to Pay Rent
results.overview: After a robotics engineer loses his job and can't find a new one in time, he makes the robot he built work three jobs to help pay rent.

results.title: Jar
results.overview: After receiving news of his mother's death, Adem returns to his hometown, which he left years ago. At home, he is met by a silent father, a resentful brother, and a past he feels estranged from. Days pass in silence, but a jar Adem finds in the cellar, a memento from his mother, becomes the first step in reuniting these long-estranged men at the same table.

results.title: A Scottish Christmas Secret
results.overview: A publisher goes to Scotland to convince an author to finish his series. While posing as a ski student, she uncovers that he's the heir to a dukedom.

results.title: Frankenbabes from Beyond the Grave!
results.overview: Frankenscience and religious ideology reanimate a cohort of recently deceased fetishists to create the perfectly subservient woman only to unleash hell on the patriarchy.

results.title: Callas, Darling
results.overview: Marie races along the highway at 240 km/h. On this August night, she doesn't want to be anywhere else. She stops at a gas station for one last cigarette and one last Capri Sun. A quiet but final farewell. But suddenly Gerlinde is standing in front of her car, and two lost souls find each other. Together they make their way south to Albania, to the childhood home of Gerlinde's deceased partner Marieta. At rest stops, in hostels and at sunsets, they meet people who want to break free - and the dissimilar women begin to question their decisions and quietly dare to hope for a new beginning.

results.title: Silvesterchlausen
results.overview: Silvesterchlausen is a mysterious tradition that takes place every New Year’s Eve in Switzerland’s Appenzell, the most conservative part of the country. Groups of six men dress in ornate costumes and engage in wordless, polyphonic yodeling and rhythmic bell clanging. The ritual has been performed for at least 500 years, but nobody knows how or why it began.

results.title: LE RAP DES ANNÉES 2000
results.overview: Documentary about French rap from the 2000s and its influence.

results.title: A World Record Christmas
results.overview: Marissa and Eric encourage their young son with autism, who is determined to set a Guinness World Record — and has the chance to do so on Christmas Eve.

results.title: Simple suture
results.overview: Laura moved to Taiwan to study traditional Chinese. After some time, she had to make a choice — either to go back to Spain or to keep memorizing words in the island.
